summary: The pre-bid conference is now mandatory and has moved a day earlier, to Monday, March 8, 2027 at 9:00 a.m.; a firm that does not sign the attendance sheet will not have its bid opened, and attendee names must be sent in by noon on Friday, March 5. Each bid must now also include a crane and lift plan and acknowledge this addendum, the bid time is confirmed as 2:00 p.m. on March 25, and the questions deadline moves to March 16.

settles.text: The original gave two times for bids on March 25, 2027: 3:00 p.m. in the Notice and 2:00 p.m. in Section 4. The addendum says the 3:00 p.m. was an error and bids are due at 2:00 p.m.

notes.text: Missing the pre-bid conference now rules a firm out: a bid from a firm that did not sign the attendance sheet will not be opened. The County will allow only one roof visit, so there is no second chance.
notes.section: 1. Pre-bid conference is now mandatory and has moved

notes.text: Names of the people attending (no more than two per firm) must reach the Facilities Director by noon on Friday, March 5, 2027, three days after this addendum was issued. The addendum does not say how to send the names or what happens if they are late. The original said those attending must bring government-issued photo identification; now that attendance is mandatory, that applies to every bidder.
notes.section: 1. Pre-bid conference is now mandatory and has moved

notes.text: The crane and lift plan must give a proposed date and hours for closing Court Street, so a bidder has to name a lift date in the bid. The addendum does not say who arranges or approves the street closure.

The requirement to acknowledge this addendum on the Bid Proposal Form is a single line at the very end, under the Questions heading, and is easy to miss. The addendum does not say what happens to a bid that leaves it out.

The heading says "Time of bid opening" but the text under it is about the time bids are due, which it confirms as 2:00 p.m. on Thursday, March 25, 2027. Neither the original nor the addendum gives a separate time for opening bids.
